run_pipeline_config_streamlit: run the streamlit page to configure and push a distilabel pipeline for synthetic data generation
push_pipeline_params_to_hub: push pipeline parameters including model URLs and generation settings to a HuggingFace Hub repo
configure_inference_models: configure self-instruction and domain expert model base URLs for the distilabel pipeline
set_generation_parameters: set temperature, max new tokens, and number of generations for instruction and response models
configure_argilla_dataset: configure Argilla API URL, API key, and dataset name for pushing generated synthetic data
